_note: Trust & Trade v2 settings. Every value here is an estimate (E) unless it says otherwise. Read by twin/freshness_v2.py, twin/trust_v2.py and (through web/trust/data/trust_v2.js) by the website.

trip._speeds_note: E – average door-to-door speeds on rural roads near Visakhapatnam incl. stops. A Google Maps Distance Matrix travel time can replace distance ÷ speed later (pass travel_h); no paid API is called.
trip._bands_note: E – the middle of each band is used.
trip._farm_wait_note: E – bundling, weighing and waiting for transport after picking ends.
trip._packing_note: E – flower temperature in the pack = outside air + bag heating (respiration heat trapped by the pack). water_factor scales the open-air water loss (1 = loose flowers in moving air).
trip._air_note: E – air speed around the flowers during the trip, used only for the water-loss term.

room._note: Inside the room the flowers sit in liners: water loss uses the twin's liner transpiration factor (config/design.json → humidity.liner_transpiration_factor).

demo._note: E – used for the tamper impact card only when no batch is in the room.
demo._control_note: E – how fast the true room follows when the controller is fooled by a faked room temperature (valve control time constant of the twin, about 30 min).
